name: android_read_shared_prefs
description: Reads a SharedPreferences XML file of an app. Needs a debuggable build of the app (`run-as`) or a rooted device; release builds return an error.

fileName.description: Optional XML file name (defaults to package_preferences.xml).

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
